card.name: Small words before risk-factor phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "at", "other", "with" or "are" right after "patients" or a condition, just before a risk, contraindication or known-risk phrase. It also fires inside "atypical" after "at".

modes.label: "at" after patients
modes.description: The word "at" after "patients" and before "risk of" or "high risk".
modes.example: administer anti-hyperuricemics to patients<< at>> risk of tumor lysis syndrome, ensure

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Words like "other", "various" or "a" that lead into a risk-factor or known-risk noun.
modes.example: especially those with<< other>> predisposing risk factors for venous throm

modes.label: Inside "atypical"
modes.description: The "ypical" piece of "atypical" before fracture or infections.
modes.example: should be suspected of having an at<<ypical>> fracture and should be evaluated to rule out
